{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data with explicit dtype specification
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv', dtype={'biomarker_baseline': 'float64'})

# Keep only the latest sample for each patient
df_latest = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the biomarker_baseline column again for any anomalies
print("Biomarker baseline values after re-loading:\n", df_latest['biomarker_baseline'].describe())

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999.0) which are common in clinical data to indicate missing or invalid
sentinel_count = (df_latest['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()
print("\nNumber of sentinel values (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline:", sentinel_count)

# Filter out sentinel values before computing the mean
valid_biomarker = df_latest['biomarker_baseline'][df_latest['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute mean for severe patients, excluding sentinel values
severe_df = df_latest[df_latest['severity'] == 'severe']
severe_valid_biomarker = severe_df['biomarker_baseline'][severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_valid_biomarker.mean()

print("\nMean baseline biomarker value for severe patients (excluding sentinel values, ng/mL):", mean_biomarker_severe)"}
